name: filesystems
description: Support and management utilities for various filesystems (FAT, NTFS, exFAT, XFS, F2FS, Btrfs, ext4, Bcachefs, Parted, GPT)
_comment: Note: Core filesystem tools are active defaults in 'packages'. Specialized tools (ZFS, ddrescue, testdisk) are listed in 'optional_packages' for easy enablement.
